tagline.en: Quad Cities to Cincinnati, diagonal across the corn belt
tagline.zh: 从四城区到辛辛那提，斜切玉米带

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 艾奥瓦州达文波特，与 I-80 相接

end.en: I-75 just north of downtown Cincinnati, Ohio
end.zh: 俄亥俄州辛辛那提市中心以北，与 I-75 相接

en: I-74 is a diagonal, which makes it unusual: the grid logic of the Interstate System gives even numbers to east–west roads, and I-74 runs northwest to southeast the whole way. It begins in the Quad Cities on the Mississippi, cuts across Illinois through Galesburg, Peoria, Bloomington–Normal, Champaign–Urbana and Danville, skirts Indianapolis on the city's beltway, and ends against I-75 in Cincinnati.

Almost the entire Illinois length runs alongside US 150, the road it replaced. In Ohio the freeway carries US 52 signs for its whole short length. Around Indianapolis it has no pavement of its own at all — traffic is routed onto I-465 and I-69.

The Interstate was also planned to continue east from Cincinnati through West Virginia and Virginia to North Carolina. That part was never built. The FHWA route log still lists disconnected I-74 mileage in North Carolina, where the number has been applied to upgraded sections of other highways, but nothing links the two.
zh: I-74 是一条斜向道路，这本身就不寻常：按州际公路系统的编号逻辑，偶数编号给东西向道路，而 I-74 全程自西北走向东南。它起于密西西比河畔的四城区，斜穿伊利诺伊，经盖尔斯堡、皮奥里亚、布卢明顿—诺默尔、香槟—厄巴纳和丹维尔，再沿印第安纳波利斯的环城公路绕过市区，最终在辛辛那提接上 I-75。
伊利诺伊境内几乎全程与 US 150 并行——后者正是被它取代的旧路。在俄亥俄，这条短短的高速公路全程挂着 US 52 的标牌。而在印第安纳波利斯周边，它根本没有自己的路面：车流被导入 I-465 与 I-69。
原本的规划还要让它自辛辛那提继续东行，穿西弗吉尼亚、弗吉尼亚直达北卡罗来纳。这一段从未建成。FHWA 的路线登记表至今仍列出北卡罗来纳境内互不相连的 I-74 里程——那里把这个编号挂在了升级改造后的其他公路上——但两者之间没有任何连接。

en: The Mississippi River crossing at the western end was rebuilt between 2017 and 2021. The bridge it replaced was a pair of suspension spans — westbound finished in 1935, eastbound in 1960 — designed for a fraction of the traffic they were carrying by the time work started.

The replacement is a twin basket-handle arch structure carrying four lanes in each direction, with a fourteen-foot bike and pedestrian path on the eastbound span and a scenic overlook at the centre of the arch. It was let as part of a seven-mile corridor rebuild that also delivered dozens of new bridges, six reconfigured interchanges and several miles of reworked local streets in Bettendorf and Moline.
The corridor project was funded jointly: overwhelmingly federal, with Iowa and Illinois each paying for their land-based contracts and splitting the river bridge between them.
zh: 西端跨密西西比河的桥梁于 2017 至 2021 年间重建。被替换的旧桥是一对悬索桥——西行桥 1935 年建成，东行桥 1960 年建成——其设计通行量远低于动工时的实际车流。
新桥为一对「篮柄式」拱桥，每向四车道，东行桥面附设 14 英尺宽的自行车与人行道，并在拱顶中央设有观景平台。它作为一项七英里走廊改建工程的一部分发包，该工程还建成数十座新桥、改造六处互通立交，并重修了贝滕多夫与莫林数英里的地方道路。
走廊工程采取联合出资：绝大部分来自联邦，艾奥瓦与伊利诺伊各自承担本州陆上标段，跨河桥梁则由两州对半分摊。

en: The number was assigned in 1957, and AASHO approved the Illinois alignment from Moline through Bloomington to the Indiana line in November 1958. The first piece of I-74 to open anywhere was in Peoria: the Illini Expressway and the Murray Baker Bridge over the Illinois River, dedicated on 12 December 1958.

Peoria paid a price for it. Clearing the line through East Peoria meant cutting into Fondulac Hill and demolishing hundreds of houses, apartment buildings and businesses. The route was extended west to Kickapoo by 1965, reached Bloomington in 1966, and the last Illinois gap, Bloomington to Mahomet, opened in late 1971.

Indiana built faster once it started. Work west of Crawfordsville began in January 1964 and finished in December 1965; the eastern part of Montgomery County followed by July 1966; and when I-74 was completed across the state in 1967 it was the first Interstate in Indiana finished end to end. Ohio's short stretch into Cincinnati was completed in 1974, and the section through Moline at the western end opened in December 1975.
zh: 编号于 1957 年确定，AASHO 于 1958 年 11 月批准了伊利诺伊境内自莫林经布卢明顿至印第安纳州界的线位。全美最早通车的一段 I-74 在皮奥里亚：伊利尼快速路与跨越伊利诺伊河的默里·贝克大桥，于 1958 年 12 月 12 日落成通车。
皮奥里亚为此付出了代价。在东皮奥里亚打通线位，意味着切开丰迪拉克山，并拆除数百栋住宅、公寓楼和商铺。此路于 1965 年前西延至基卡普，1966 年抵达布卢明顿，伊利诺伊境内最后一处缺口——布卢明顿至马霍梅——于 1971 年年末通车。
印第安纳一旦动工，速度就快得多。克劳福兹维尔以西的工程 1964 年 1 月开工、1965 年 12 月完工；蒙哥马利县东部随后于 1966 年 7 月建成；1967 年 I-74 全州贯通时，它是印第安纳第一条首尾建成的州际公路。俄亥俄通往辛辛那提的短短一段 1974 年完工，而西端穿越莫林的路段则在 1975 年 12 月通车。

why.en: No public figure exists. Four states built the Midwest route between 1958 and 1975, around Indianapolis it uses pavement built and paid for as I-465 and I-69, and federal aid was accounted for by state and fiscal year rather than by route.
why.zh: 无公开数据。四个州于 1958 至 1975 年间建成中西部路段，在印第安纳波利斯周边它借用的是以 I-465 和 I-69 名义建设并付款的路面；联邦补助按州和财政年度而非按路线核算。

value.en: 391.30 miles across 4 states for the Midwest route — Illinois 214.88, Indiana 151.26, Ohio 19.73, Iowa 5.43 — plus a disconnected 69.67 miles in North Carolina, for a route-log total of 460.97
value.zh: 中西部路段共 391.30 英里，横跨 4 个州：伊利诺伊 214.88、印第安纳 151.26、俄亥俄 19.73、艾奥瓦 5.43；此外北卡罗来纳另有互不相连的 69.67 英里，登记表总计 460.97 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

label.zh: 跨密西西比河桥梁合同

value.en: Won on a bid of $322 million; the Iowa DOT authorised up to $74.5 million in additional construction costs, taking it to $396 million
value.zh: 中标价 3.22 亿美元；艾奥瓦州交通部另核准最多 7,450 万美元追加施工费用，总额升至 3.96 亿美元

value.en: Approximately $1 billion, the largest project ever let by the Iowa DOT; about 88.5 per cent federally funded
value.zh: 约 10 亿美元，是艾奥瓦州交通部有史以来发包的最大项目；约 88.5% 由联邦出资

figures.source: Roads & Bridges, December 2021; Benesch project record, 2023

why.en: No agency publishes a route-wide figure. Counts are collected per segment by four state transportation departments, and around Indianapolis the traffic on I-74's designated path cannot be separated from I-465 and I-69.
why.zh: 没有机构发布全线数字。交通量由四个州的交通部门分段采集；在印第安纳波利斯周边，I-74 指定路径上的车流无法与 I-465、I-69 分开统计。

value.en: The old suspension bridges were designed for 48,000 vehicles a day; average daily counts had passed 74,000 when construction on the replacement began in 2017
value.zh: 旧悬索桥的设计通行量为每日 48,000 辆；2017 年新桥开工时，日均实测流量已超过 74,000 辆

timeline.en: AASHO releases the preliminary Interstate numbering plan for Illinois, with I-74 running from Moline southeast to the Indiana line.
timeline.zh: AASHO 公布伊利诺伊州际公路初步编号方案，I-74 自莫林东南行至印第安纳州界。

timeline.en: The Illini Expressway and the Murray Baker Bridge at Peoria are dedicated on 12 December — the first section of I-74 open anywhere. AASHO approves the Illinois alignment the month before.
timeline.zh: 12 月 12 日，皮奥里亚的伊利尼快速路与默里·贝克大桥落成通车，是全美最早通车的 I-74 路段。前一个月 AASHO 批准了伊利诺伊线位。

timeline.en: I-74 is completed across Indiana, the first Interstate in the state finished end to end.
timeline.zh: I-74 在印第安纳全州贯通，成为该州第一条首尾建成的州际公路。

timeline.en: The last Illinois gap, Bloomington to Mahomet, opens in late autumn.
timeline.zh: 深秋时节，伊利诺伊最后一处缺口——布卢明顿至马霍梅——通车。

timeline.en: The Ohio section into Cincinnati is completed, connecting I-74 to I-75.
timeline.zh: 通往辛辛那提的俄亥俄路段完工，I-74 与 I-75 相连。

timeline.en: The section through Moline at the western end opens on 10 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 10 日，西端穿越莫林的路段通车。

timeline.en: Upgrade 74, the rebuild of I-74 through Peoria and East Peoria, breaks ground in October; it finishes in November 2006.
timeline.zh: 10 月，贯穿皮奥里亚与东皮奥里亚的 I-74 改建工程「Upgrade 74」动工，2006 年 11 月完工。

timeline.en: The new twin-arch Mississippi River bridge opens fully to traffic on 3 December, a year behind schedule.
timeline.zh: 12 月 3 日，新建的双拱跨密西西比河桥梁全面通车，比原计划晚了一年。
